children.description: Habitat and conservation: — Clusia nubium occurs in lower montane cloud forests of Southern Ecuador. The montane forests in the Sambotambo area are situated on the western slopes of the Andes just outside the mouth of the dry valley of Piñas, and are frequently covered by clouds formed by the rise of moisture laden air blowing in from the Pacific Ocean. The new species appears to be endemic to this region that is also home to a variety of other narrowly endemic plant species (Borchsenius 1997).
